entries.issue: Acuerdo 028 names NSR-98; Acuerdo 076 later names NRS-10 in selected height provisions.
entries.resolution: Record both as context; this is not a blanket blocker to the incorporated historical model.

entries.issue: Acuerdo 028 incorporates Acuerdo 012, but separate official bytes for Acuerdo 012 were not located.
entries.resolution: Preserve the official incorporation finding; keep only the missing numerical annex as an activation gap.

entries.issue: Earlier wording counted 3A/3B as separate design zones.
entries.resolution: Use five design zones and record 3A/3B as Zone 3 subareas.
